name: civicpulse
description: CivicPulse foundation for AI-assisted civic development prioritization

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @civicpulse/web" "npm run dev --workspace @civicpulse/api"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @civicpulse/shared && npm run test --workspace @civicpulse/web && npm run test --workspace @civicpulse/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @civicpulse/shared && npm run lint --workspace @civicpulse/web && npm run lint --workspace @civicpulse/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @civicpulse/web && npm run build --workspace @civicpulse/api
